items: 开放五个平台网页登录，自动打开登录界面，并修复凭据认证、取消和保存重启恢复。
完善凭据提示及游戏选择框布局；任务运行记录只显示最近一次签到结果。
已保存凭据支持安全回读和密码框显示；清除凭据在保存任务后生效。需要 Host 0.17.1。
适配 Host 0.17.0 与 Plugin API 2.1，保持现役业务和数据隔离。

en-US.description: Create multi-platform game check-in tasks using host global notifications and local schedules.

items: Enables browser login for all five platforms, opens login dialogs automatically, and improves credential validation, cancellation, and persistence.
Refines credential hints and game selection layout; each task displays only its latest sign-in run.
Read saved credentials in password fields; clearing takes effect after saving the task. Requires Host 0.17.1.
Targets Host 0.17.0 and Plugin API 2.1 while preserving current behavior and data isolation.

description: 创建多平台游戏签到任务，配置本机时区计划、手动执行、运行结果与宿主全局通知。
